Name: process_mode
Description: Processing mode, selected from PluginControl::ProcessMode. In deepstream-app PGIE uses PROCESS_MODE_FULL_FRAME by default, SGIE use PROCESS_MODE_CLIP_OBJECTS by default

Name: operate_on_gie_id
Description: Unique ID of the GIE on whose metadata (bounding boxes) this GIE is to operate on
Type and Range:
int32, >=0, valid gie-id.
-1, disable gie-id check, inference on all GIE Ids

Name: operate_on_class_ids
Description: Class IDs of the parent GIE on which this GIE is to operate on
Example Notes:
operate_on_class_ids: [1, 2]
Operates on objects with class IDs 1, 2 generated by parent GIE

Name: interval
Description: Specifies the number of consecutive, batches to be skipped for inference. default is 0

Name: async_mode
Description: Enables inference on detected objects and asynchronous metadata attachments. Works only when tracker-ids are attached. Pushes buffer downstream without waiting for inference results. Attaches metadata after the inference

Name: object_control
secondary_reinfer_interval
Description: Re-inference interval for objects, in frames
